law: Environment Conservation Act 1995; Environment Conservation Rules 2023 (SRO No. 53)
title: Obtain a location clearance certificate before establishing the facility
description: Industrial units in the Yellow, Orange and Red categories must obtain location clearance before environmental clearance.
review_note: Confirmed from secondary summaries of ECR 2023 (UNEP LEAP record, Enviliance). Verify against the official gazette schedule.

law: Environment Conservation Act 1995; Environment Conservation Rules 2023 (SRO No. 53)
title: Hold a valid Environmental Clearance Certificate (ECC) and renew it before expiry
description: Industrial units classified Green, Yellow, Orange or Red require environmental clearance; the certificate must be renewed periodically.
frequency: Renew before expiry (validity period depends on category; confirm in the Rules)
review_note: Renewal periods per category are not seeded: they come only from secondary sources so far.

regulator: Department of Inspection for Factories and Establishments (DIFE)
law: Bangladesh Labour Act 2006, section 90A; Bangladesh Labour Rules 2015 (S.R.O. No. 291-Law/2015), rule 81
title: Constitute a Safety Committee (6-12 members, equal employer and worker representatives)
description: Every factory or industrial establishment where 50 or more workers are employed at any time of the year must form a Safety Committee; a new factory within 9 months of starting production.
frequency: Ongoing; form within 9 months of starting production
review_note: Rule 81 text checked in the unofficial English translation of the gazette (15 September 2015). A 2025-2026 amendment may widen scope beyond factories; review.
